narrative:

This factor strongly pushed the prediction toward a "bad credit risk" for you.

The third key factor was the duration of your requested loan, which is 36 months. This is nearly double the average of 19 months for approved applicants. A longer loan term increases the period of uncertainty for the lender, and this pushed the prediction further toward a denial.

These factors, combined with the main ones, painted a picture of higher risk.

To improve your chances in the future, consider building up your savings and checking account balance to show greater financial stability. You might also look into securing a guarantor or co-applicant, as this was a common trait among approved borrowers. Finally, requesting a smaller loan amount over a shorter period could make your application more favorable.
